VOLT 47 is a self-initiated brand identity and logo animation for a 24-hour gym in a dense city: the kind of place that fills at 6am, empties at noon and fills again long after midnight.VOLT 47 is a self-initiated brand identity and logo animation for a 24-hour gym in a dense city: the kind of place that fills at 6am, empties at noon and fills again long after midnight.

The challenge

A 24-hour gym never closes, so its identity has to:

  • Work at any hour, day or night
  • Hold at any size, from a 16px app icon to a lit shopfront sign

The approach

One shape, read three ways: a wedge cut at 23°, three barbell plates locking around it, and a bolt struck out of the middle as negative space. That 23° angle then runs through everything after it.

The details

  • The angle shapes the badge, the slash pattern, the towel stripes and the locker tag
  • Flat vector geometry with no strokes or live effects, so it holds at any size
  • Volt is the only colour that shouts, and never more than once per layout
  • Type set in Anton and Space Grotesk
  • An eight-second logo reveal with sound, 1920×1080

VOLT 47 is a fictional brand and is not affiliated with any existing business.

how it landed

OutcomeOutcome

A self-initiated concept, so these are the checks it is designed to pass, not live numbers.

What I delivered

  • Logo suite, colour and type system
  • A pattern built on the 23° angle
  • Eight brand applications and a three-post social kit
  • An eight-second logo reveal with sound

How I’d measure success

  • Recognition of the mark at app-icon size and on a lit sign
  • Consistency: every touchpoint built from one angle and one accent colour
  • Quick recall: can people redraw the mark after a glance
  • Engagement on the launch posts

What it shows

  • Building a whole identity from one idea
  • Restraint with colour: one light in a black room
  • Systems thinking from a 16px icon to a shopfront
  • Logo animation and sound
